text: I want to build a website for my business.
I need an app that helps people manage their tasks.
I want to sell products online.
Help me do marketing for my startup.
I want a website and some way to get more customers.
I want to create an online store for handmade jewelry. I need product pages, a shopping cart, and something for payments. I'd like it to look clean and modern.
I'm building a SaaS tool for small accounting firms. It should let them track client invoices, send reminders, and generate monthly reports. I want a subscription model.
I need a website for my restaurant in Paris. It should show the menu, allow table reservations, and have a contact page. We post a lot on Instagram so maybe something for that too.
I want to run a digital marketing campaign for my new fitness app. The target is people aged 25–40 who like running. I want to use Instagram and Google Ads.
I need a portfolio website to showcase my graphic design work and get freelance clients. I want a gallery, a contact form, and maybe a small blog.
I want to build an internal dashboard for my team of 10 people to track sales leads, assign tasks, and see a pipeline overview. Nothing fancy, just functional.
I want an e-commerce site for a French bakery. It should support online ordering with delivery and pickup options, a loyalty points system, and Stripe for payments.
I want to build a community platform for indie makers — a place to share projects, get feedback, and connect with other builders. Think Product Hunt but smaller and more personal.
I need to set up email marketing for my online store. I want welcome sequences, abandoned cart emails, and a weekly newsletter. My list is around 2,000 subscribers.
I want to build an MVP for a mobile app that connects dog owners with local dog walkers. Users should be able to post a request, walkers apply, and payment happens in the app.

I want to build a multi-vendor e-commerce marketplace for vintage clothing in France. It needs seller registration with ID verification, a product listing system with photos and condition ratings, Stripe Connect for split payments, a review system, and a buyer dispute mechanism. Target is 18–35 year olds. I want it to work great on mobile. SEO is important. I need an admin dashboard to manage sellers and resolve disputes. Budget is flexible but I want to launch in 4 months.

I'm launching a SaaS product for freelance translators. It manages projects, tracks word counts and deadlines, and generates invoices automatically. I want a free trial, then €29/month. My launch plan is to target LinkedIn groups for translators and run a ProductHunt launch. I need a landing page, onboarding emails, and a referral program.

Our consulting firm needs a complete website redesign. We have 5 service lines, a team of 30, and about 40 case studies we want to feature. The new site needs to feel premium, load fast, and be easy for our non-technical team to update. We use HubSpot for CRM and want the contact forms to sync with it. We also want a blog and maybe a resources section with downloadable white papers.

We're a B2B cybersecurity company targeting CTOs and IT directors at mid-sized companies (50–500 employees) in Germany. We want to run a 3-month demand generation campaign combining LinkedIn ads, a thought leadership content series (5 articles), a webinar, and a gated whitepaper. Goal is 50 qualified leads per month with a CPL under €150.

I want to build both a website and a mobile app for a home cleaning service. The website should explain the service and let people book. The app is for cleaners — they see their daily schedule, mark jobs complete, and get paid weekly. Customers can rate cleaners. I also want push notifications for booking confirmations and reminders.
Patient has lung cancer. Started chemo last month. Follow-up in 6 weeks.
Patient underwent surgery. Recovery going well. Will check labs next visit.
MRI shows a lesion in the left temporal lobe, approximately 2.3 cm. No midline shift. Patient complains of occasional headaches and some memory difficulty.

Patient is a 58-year-old woman diagnosed with stage II breast cancer, ER-positive, HER2-negative. She completed 6 cycles of AC-T chemotherapy 8 months ago. No current active treatment. She's asking about hormone therapy options.

We are planning to start radiotherapy for this patient next week. The target volume includes the primary tumor and regional nodes. We'll do 25 fractions. Patient has some cardiac history so we'll need to be careful with dosing on the left side.

Patient is a 72-year-old male with a history of type 2 diabetes (on metformin 1g twice daily), hypertension (lisinopril 10mg), and was recently diagnosed with non-Hodgkin lymphoma, diffuse large B-cell type, stage III-A. He's being evaluated for R-CHOP. His last HbA1c was 7.8%. Renal function: creatinine 1.4 mg/dL. No known drug allergies.

A 9-year-old boy with ALL, currently in maintenance phase. He's on 6-MP and weekly methotrexate. His recent CBC showed neutropenia (ANC 650). His parents are concerned about school attendance and infection risk.

Patient with stage IV pancreatic cancer, metastatic to liver. Performance status declining — ECOG 3. Family has been informed of prognosis. Patient wishes to avoid hospitalization and wants to remain at home. Pain currently managed with oxycodone 10mg q6h but breakthrough pain is increasing.

Patient completed 4 cycles of FOLFOX for colorectal cancer. CT scan shows partial response — main lesion reduced from 4.1cm to 2.8cm. Two small liver metastases unchanged. Planning surgical consultation for potential resection. Patient tolerating treatment well, mild peripheral neuropathy grade 1.

Saw the patient today. Things look okay. We'll continue the current plan and see how the numbers look at the next visit. She mentioned some fatigue but I think that's expected. Let's check the usual labs.

Patient presents with a suspicious lesion on the right forearm, approximately 1.8cm, irregular border, mixed pigmentation. Biopsy pending. Patient has a family history of melanoma. No prior skin cancers. Sun exposure history: significant (outdoor worker for 20 years).

For this patient we are considering two options: continuing current hormonal therapy or switching to a CDK4/6 inhibitor given recent progression markers. Insurance situation is unclear. Patient is 67, lives alone, has mild cognitive impairment. Caregiver involvement will be important for compliance.

Patient: 45-year-old female. Diagnosis: Triple-negative breast cancer, stage IIB (T2N1M0). Treatment history: 4 cycles neoadjuvant chemotherapy (paclitaxel + carboplatin), then modified radical mastectomy with sentinel node biopsy (2/4 nodes positive). Adjuvant chemotherapy completed (capecitabine, 8 cycles). Currently disease-free at 18-month follow-up. Surveillance: clinical exam every 3 months, annual mammography of remaining breast, annual chest CT. No current medications beyond vitamin D supplementation. Patient reports good quality of life, some arm lymphedema, enrolled in physical therapy.

Starting radiation for this patient Monday. He has prostate cancer, Gleason 7 (4+3), T2cN0M0. We're going with moderately hypofractionated IMRT — 60 Gy in 20 fractions. He's also on ADT (leuprolide, started 3 months ago, will continue 18 months total). PSA at last check was 0.8. He's otherwise healthy, no significant comorbidities. Main concern is rectal toxicity given prior sigmoid surgery.

MDT discussion for patient with hepatocellular carcinoma. Background: cirrhosis (Child-Pugh B7), HCV-related, treated with sofosbuvir 2 years ago (SVR achieved). Single lesion 3.2cm segment 6, AFP 320 ng/mL. BCLC stage A. Liver transplant team says he qualifies for Milan criteria. Surgical resection also discussed but hepatic reserve is marginal. Locoregional option: TACE or ablation as bridge to transplant. Decision: refer to transplant list, TACE as bridge. Patient informed and agreeable.
I want to start trading crypto. Don't go crazy with the spending.
I need to accept payments on my website.
Set up my Binance account to do some automated trading. Keep the risk low.
I want to stake some ETH and maybe provide liquidity somewhere. Make sure I don't lose too much.
Create a trading bot that buys when things look good and sells when they go down.

I want to set up an automated trading account for Bitcoin and Ethereum only. My total portfolio is $10,000. Don't invest more than 20% in a single trade. Stop trading for the day if I'm down more than $500.

I'm building an online marketplace and need to handle payments. Sellers should receive their cut automatically after a 7-day holding period. I need to support card payments and maybe PayPal. I'm based in France, so VAT needs to be handled correctly.

I have a crypto portfolio with BTC, ETH, and some altcoins. I want to set rules: never more than 40% in altcoins, rebalance monthly, and if BTC drops more than 15% in a week, reduce all positions by half. Also, never sell during a weekend.

I want an AI trading agent for the Nasdaq. It should use momentum strategies, only trade liquid large-caps (top 100 by volume), never hold overnight, and limit daily losses to 2% of portfolio value. Risk level: medium. I'm in the US, so pattern day trader rules apply.

I'm building a platform for freelancers to get paid internationally. Most of my users are in Southeast Asia getting paid by US and EU clients. I need to support USD, EUR, and local currencies, handle FX conversion, and keep fees under 2%. Wire transfers and local bank deposits both needed.

I want to interact with Uniswap and Aave automatically. On Uniswap, I'll provide liquidity to the ETH/USDC pool and auto-compound rewards. On Aave, I want to supply ETH as collateral and borrow USDC up to 50% LTV. Set a liquidation alert at 65% LTV. Total capital: 5 ETH.

I'm launching a SaaS and need subscription billing. Plans are €9/month (basic), €29/month (pro), and €99/month (team, up to 10 seats). I want annual billing with a 20% discount, automatic dunning for failed payments, and a 14-day free trial. I'm using Stripe.

I want to configure a multi-exchange automated trading system. Exchanges: Binance (spot) and Coinbase Pro (spot only, no margin). Assets: BTC, ETH, SOL only. Max per-trade size: 5% of portfolio. Daily loss limit: 3% of total portfolio — if hit, all trading stops until manual reset. Weekly drawdown limit: 8%. No trading between 23:00 and 06:00 UTC. Minimum 4 hours between trades on the same asset. Never trade within 30 minutes of a major economic announcement (use economic calendar API). Slippage tolerance: max 0.3%. All trades must log to a Google Sheet in real time.

I want to build a small crypto exchange for European users. I need to support BTC, ETH, and a few stablecoins (USDC, USDT). I need KYC/AML compliance for EU regulations, a matching engine, a wallet system with hot/cold split, and fiat onramps via SEPA bank transfer. Security: 2FA, withdrawal email confirmation, and IP whitelisting. I want to start with a limited beta of 500 users.
I want an AI to manage my investments. Keep it safe but make it grow. I don't want to check it every day. Just don't do anything stupid.
